title: CollationKit interchange
description: The cross-language JSON interchange emitted by `collate-demo --json`: the N-witness variant graph plus each successive pairwise collation. This is the wire contract a web/WASM consumer or a comparison harness reads, and the shape every conformance golden must validate against. Mirrors the CollationJSON DTOs in Sources/CollationKit/CollationJSON.swift; bump `schemaVersion` (and the matching const below) on any breaking change.

pairs.description: One PairwiseDTO per successive (base, compared) pair of witnesses, in witness order.

schemaVersion.description: Wire-contract version. Constant for a given release; bump on any breaking shape change. v3 (B6c): the variant graph can now contain INSERTED nodes — `basePosition` may be -1 and a new optional `insertedAfter` records the base position an insertion follows.

VariationType.description: The typed classification of a single point of variance.

MoveConfidence.description: For a transposition: how sure the engine is it is a real move. 'certain' = anchored or an exact displaced-word match (unique key, identical normalisation); 'likely' = a heuristic near-match (misspelling/synonym) to be surfaced as tentative. Always 'certain' for non-transposition variations.

LocationDTO.description: Where a reading sits in its witness: 0-based coordinates plus the 1-based human citation.

VariationDTO.description: A single typed, located point of variance between base and compared witness.

crossesPage.description: True when this variant spans a page boundary.

withinTransposition.description: True when this variant sits inside a moved (transposed) span.

PairwiseDTO.description: The located variant report for one (base, compared) pair.

ReadingDTO.description: One reading at a graph node and the sorted sigla that carry it.

witnesses.description: Sigla carrying this reading, sorted (determinism rule §9.5).

GraphNodeDTO.description: One position in the variant graph. Normally keyed to a base position; an INSERTED node (B6c) — text some witnesses add where the base has nothing — has basePosition -1 and carries `insertedAfter`.

basePosition.description: Position in the base witness, or -1 for an inserted node (text absent from the base).

insertedAfter.description: For an inserted node: the base position this insertion follows (-1 = before all base text). Absent for a normal base-anchored node.

isVariant.description: True when witnesses disagree at this node.

readings.description: Distinct readings at this node, sorted by reading (deterministic). For an inserted node, the witnesses that omit the insertion carry the reading "∅".

GraphDTO.description: The N-witness variant graph, aligned against a base witness.

baseID.description: Siglum of the base witness the graph is aligned to.
